name: portfolio
description: Personal portfolio — Next.js frontend + NestJS API

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run start:prod --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
